scope: Local wire-EDM straight-profile verification; not a full manufacturing or production certification
root_cause: File-Z horizontal/vertical face percentages changed with rotation and could pass a stepped or bossed shape.
fix: Reuse full flat-extrusion verification and actual-face candidate axes. Exact positive geometry passes; source rounding and unproved/simplified geometry receive explicit setup-review warnings. Preserve taper/multi-axis possibility.

native.156-plate-with-boss.step: Wire EDM Advisory90, PRISMATIC_PROFILE_UNVERIFIED; visible setup-review card; preview ready

source_reference.supports: Manufacturer documents taper and multi-axis options; non-straight profiles are not universally impossible.

release: Not deployed. PR107 remains draft. Production baseline recorded as09555c1. No release approval for this PR.

Other file-orientation-dependent checks remain open; rotated bar still exposes CNC3 undercut behavior.
Full user goal remains open: real services, customer/physical accuracy, security, production preflight/approval/rollout and ledger completion.
